articles.summary: Moto Morini, the legendary Italian motorcycle manufacturer, has deployed Ekho's AI Sales Agent on motomoriniusa.com to engage and qualify buyers around the clock. The AI handles buyer conversations in real time — answering product questions, qualifying purchase intent, and routing ready-to-buy leads to the nearest dealer across Moto Morini's growing U.S. dealer network.
articles.title: Moto Morini Deploys Ekho's AI Sales Agent Across U.S. Website and Dealer Network

articles.summary: The Knowledge Hub is live. Upload any number of documents to the Admin Portal and the Sales Agent answers from them on web chat and over SMS, so buyers get your dealership's answer rather than a generic one.
articles.title: The Knowledge Hub Is Live

articles.summary: Parts and accessories carry 32.6% gross margin, vs. 3 to 8% on new vehicles. Most of those dollars never make it into the deal. Ekho just made accessories a built-in step of every vehicle purchase.
articles.title: Accessories Drive Margin. Why Aren't They in Every Deal?

articles.summary: Used listings now carry cosmetic, mechanical, title and history, and dealer warranty reports. A dealership records them once against the unit and decides which ones buyers see, so a remote buyer can judge a used vehicle before they commit to it.
articles.title: Condition and History Reports Are Live on Used Inventory

articles.summary: The FTC’s March 2026 warning letters to 97 auto dealership groups marked a turning point: the agency is enforcing total-price disclosure case by case, and OEMs in powersports, marine, RV and LSV are already advising dealers to revisit how they advertise. This piece breaks down where dealers actually get exposed, why the same patterns extend across every titled-vehicle segment, and how disclosure-by-design turns compliance into a byproduct of a cleaner buyer experience.
articles.title: The end of the price-on-the-windshield era
